cells.gaps: No source found gives an enforcement or redress decision under a rule on AI harms. The November 2025 remand over an AI-made video was a charge of insulting the head of state under the Penal Code.
cells.note: The social-network ordinance and its October 2026 ratifying law ban deepfakes and require AI-content labels, and ordinance 0013 gives the HAC the task of auditing AI systems, which meets questions 2 and 3. A remand under a general Penal Code article is not a decision under those rules, so 4.
